title: Monster
desc: Anjanam, who respects all life forms, faces trouble after a rat creates havoc in his house. While he tries to get rid of the rodent, a criminal breaks into his home to find his missing diamonds.

title: Saravanan Irukka Bayamaen
desc: Saravanan, a lackadaisical young man, stumbles into power as the local political head. Subsequently, armed with clueless confidence, he uses his new role to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Kazhugu 2
desc: Two thieves get mistaken for huntsmen upon reaching a new place. So, they use the misunderstanding as an opportunity to take advantage and hide from the law.

title: Vacha Kuri Thappaathu
desc: Karthik, a businessman, gets married to a rich woman, to increase his wealth. However, things change, when he falls in love with an environmental activist, who files a suit against his company.

title: Thambi
desc: Parvathy is hesitant to accept her brother, Saravanan, who returns home after 15 years. Soon, she discovers that not everything is as it seems and uncovers a well-planned conspiracy.

title: Ungalukkaga Oruvan
desc: A wealthy entrepreneur returns home to reconcile with a former classmate. Upon discovering his companion's dire predicament, he intervenes and becomes a heroic saviour for the entire community.

title: Killer
desc: In Vizag and Aruku, a series of murders unfold. Meanwhile, a couple unknowingly visits Aruku during their vacation, only for the woman to mysteriously disappear.

title: Raid
desc: In what may be the longest raid of his career, a righteous income tax officer takes on a corrupt politician who will go to any lengths to evade legal consequences.

title: Vengamamba
desc: Vengamamba's life becomes chaotic when her husband dies. Meanwhile, an ardent devotee of Lord Venkateswara tries to help her through difficult times.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Chakravyuham: The Trap
desc: Satya, an investigating officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges to solve the murder case of a businessman's wife.

title: Penguin
desc: Rhythm, a pregnant woman, is traumatised by nightmares about the unsolved kidnapping of her first child, Ajay. Later, she embarks on a harrowing mission to solve the mystery of his disappearance.

title: Dear Comrade
desc: Bobby, a student union leader with anger issues, falls in love with Lilly, a state-level cricketer. However, his temperament poses an obstacle in his path to be with her.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Majili
desc: Poorna, an aspiring cricketer, falls into a deep depression after being abandoned by his lover, Anshu. Despite this, he is forced to marry his neighbour Sravani, who secretly has feelings for him.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: Visithiran
desc: A retired policeman known for his investigative skills grieves the death of his wife. However, things take a turn when he gets embroiled in a human trafficking case.
